verdict.rationale: Before a run, Consensus lets researchers pick depth by choosing Deep Search for more comprehensive literature reviews. They can narrow scope with filters (study type, year, journal, discipline), Medical Mode, and a preprint-exclusion flag. Nothing shows effort tuning beyond the mode choice, or any way to steer a run while it executes. Missing for 10: granular depth/effort parameters, mid-run steering or redirection, and independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a researcher, I can steer the depth, effort, and scope of a research run before or while it executes

citations.quote: Deep Searches (more comprehensive Lit Reviews across many studies)
Filters allow narrowing by study type (RCT, meta-analysis, systematic review, observational), publication year, journal, open-access status, and discipline.
Clinicians often need insights drawn only from top medical journals and clinical guidelines — the gold standard of evidence.That's why we're introducing Medical Mode in Consensus.
pass `exclude_preprints=true` (MCP) or `excludePreprints=true` (REST API) to filter to peer-reviewed papers only.
